headline: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Dow Jones Futures Down As Santa Rally Hopes Fade—Investors Await Initial Jobless Claims Report
summary: U.S. stock futures declined on New Year's Eve as hopes for a year-end Santa Claus rally fade. Markets remain jittery following President Trump's threats against Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell. Investors await the Initial Jobless Claims report before market open. The S&P 500, Dow Jones, and Nasdaq 100 all traded lower in premarket, with several individual stocks showing significant moves based on company announcements and FDA approvals.
categories: stock market,S&P 500,Dow Jones futures,Santa rally,jobless claims,Federal Reserve,Jerome Powell,premarket trading,biotech stocks,FDA approval

headline: Why Did Oriental Rise Holdings (ORIS) Shares Surge Over 47% After Hours?
summary: Oriental Rise Holdings (NASDAQ: ORIS) shares surged 47.54% to $1.80 in after-hours trading following the announcement of a non-binding letter of intent to acquire a controlling stake in Hubei Daguan Tea Industry Group Co. Ltd. The acquisition aims to secure upstream resources and improve supply chain control, product differentiation, and long-term shareholder value. However, the stock remains near its 52-week low and has declined 95.7% over the past 12 months.
categories: acquisition,tea industry,supply chain,strategic investment,after-hours trading,vertically integrated operations

headline: Oriental Rise Holding Limited Signs Non-Binding Letter of Intent to Acquire Hubei Daguan Tea Industry Group
summary: Oriental Rise Holdings (NASDAQ: ORIS), a Chinese integrated tea supplier, announced a non-binding letter of intent to acquire a controlling stake in Hubei Daguan Tea Industry Group. The proposed acquisition aims to strengthen upstream supply control, improve product mix, and advance the company's vertical integration strategy by combining Oriental Rise's public platform and distribution network with Daguan Tea's cultivation, processing, and production capabilities.

headline: Herzfeld Credit Income Fund, Inc. Pays Distribution
summary: Herzfeld Credit Income Fund (NASDAQ: HERZ) announced a year-end distribution of $0.6867 per share paid on December 30, 2025. The distribution was paid 80% in shares and 20% in cash, with the entire amount sourced from net realized long-term capital gains. The fund reported a negative 5-year average annual return of -2.62% relative to NAV.

headline: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of SCHMID Group N.V. - SHMD
summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims on behalf of investors of SCHMID Group N.V. (NASDAQ: SHMD). The investigation was triggered after Schmid received a Nasdaq delisting notice on November 17, 2025, due to failure to file its 2024 annual report. The stock price fell 31.51% following the announcement, closing at $3.76 per share on November 18, 2025.
categories: securities fraud,class action lawsuit,Nasdaq delisting,annual report filing,stock price decline,investor investigation

headline: iSpecimen Inc. Announces Pricing of ~$5.5 Million Private Placement
summary: iSpecimen Inc. (Nasdaq: ISPC), an online marketplace for biospecimens, announced a securities purchase agreement with accredited investors for approximately $5.5 million in gross proceeds. The company will issue 6,875 shares of Series C Convertible Preferred Stock at $800 per share, convertible into common stock at 85% of the closing price. Net proceeds will be used for marketing, working capital, and general corporate purposes, with the offering expected to close on December 31, 2025.
categories: capital raise,preferred stock offering,biospecimens marketplace,private placement,accredited investors,convertible securities

headline: PAVmed Announces Reverse Stock Split
summary: PAVmed Inc. announced a 1-for-30 reverse stock split effective January 2, 2026, to comply with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The split was approved by stockholders on December 5, 2025, and authorized shares will be reduced from 250 million to 25 million. The company's stock will continue trading under symbol PAVM on Nasdaq Capital Market.
categories: reverse stock split,Nasdaq compliance,minimum bid price,medical technology,stock restructuring

headline: Captivision Engages Firm to Validate Proven Mining Reserves Ahead of Planned Acquisition
summary: Captivision Inc. (Nasdaq: CAPT) has engaged Hard Rock Consulting, LLC to reaffirm gold and precious metals reserves at Montana Tunnels Mining, Inc., a subsidiary it plans to acquire. Upon completion, Captivision will reposition as a diversified gold mining company and rebrand as Montana Gold Inc. (Nasdaq: MGI). The engagement includes mineral resource updates, mine planning, and economic evaluation to support the planned acquisition and future mining operations.
categories: gold mining,acquisition,Montana Tunnels Mining,mineral reserves,Hard Rock Consulting,strategic transformation,mining operations
